description:
Import an external Git repository into the TailwindTraders project and standardizes its branching.

Your task:
1. Open the TailwindTraders project in Azure DevOps.
2. Import a new repository named 'LegacyPrototype' from this external URL: https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git
3. The source repository uses 'master' as its default branch. You must create a new branch named 'main' based on 'master'.
4. Configure the repository settings to make 'main' the new Default Branch.
